mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id, doc_id, token, created_at, expires_at FROM req_doc_share WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND doc_id = #{docId}
SELECT workspace_id, doc_id, token, created_at, expires_at FROM req_doc_share WHERE token = #{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO req_doc_share (workspace_id, doc_id, token, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{docId}, #{token}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{expiresAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE token = VALUES(token), created_at = VALUES(created_at), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM req_doc_share WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND doc_id = #{docId}
